english.note: IELTS each section5.0; Duolingo each section95. PTE50 and iTEP3.8 accepted centrally. Exemptions for US or listed-country education. Department requires TOEFL speaking26 for a teaching assistantship and spoken-English certification; confirm current-scale equivalent rather than infer.

documents: Official postsecondary records with certified English translations
Statement of purpose including research interests
GRE or MCAT, or research portfolio
requirements.note: Undergraduate GPA3.3; master’s or combined bachelor/master GPA3.5. GRE or MCAT at least50th percentile in every category can be replaced by research portfolio (contact director), including previous-project summary, an additional research-focused recommendation and publications if available. Thus portfolio route needs a third letter. Bachelor equivalent required centrally.

funding.note: Competitive TA/RA support may include tuition and stipend, typically no more than six years. Funding is not guaranteed; award thresholds exceed admission minima. Limited service-based tuition waivers may also be available. International TA applicants have additional spoken-English requirements.
